finding.claim: Join's password, joinable, and version/mod checks are ineffective: the `return` in the WithReadLock closure only exits the closure, so a mismatch still falls through to UnsafeNewPeer and adds the caller as a peer. Password-protected, non-joinable, and checksum-mismatched lobbies can be joined.
finding.source: Request body fields Id, Password, AppBinaryChecksum, DataChecksum, ModDllFile/Checksum, ModName, ModVersion, VersionFlags (join.go:34-37, bound via i.Bind) with any valid sessionID (sessionMiddleware.go:22-34).
finding.sink: advertisements.UnsafeNewPeer (join.go:85) which stores the attacker as a peer; success response with match IP and ports (join.go:110-111).

finding.guards_checked: Session required (SessionMiddleware, game.go:162 route under game.go:285). Party check at join.go:65 is a real return and is fine. Join's own-lobby removal is fine. Checks inside the closure are the only password/joinable/checksum controls, and they are no-ops. Impact: anyone with a session (default Authentication='disabled') can join locked lobbies and get the match IP/ports; the attacker must know the advertisement id, which the lobby listing routes expose.

finding.sink: adv.UnsafeUpdate(&q) (update.go:43, models/advertisement.go:356-379) mutating another user's lobby.

finding.guards_checked: SessionMiddleware only (sessionMiddleware.go:22-34). No hostId or session-user comparison in update.go. Route registered at game.go:166 for all titles. Impact: a player can lock out or hijack another player's lobby, set the password to block others, or flip state, which also affects ADV-UPDATESTATE-1.

finding.guards_checked: SessionMiddleware only. Route game.go:192 for all titles. No host check. Impact: forced match start or state corruption for other players' lobbies, and forced notifications to every peer.

finding.claim: Host takes the host user id from the request body (AdvertisementHostRequest.HostId, schema hostid) instead of the session. Any authenticated session can create a lobby as another user, which evicts that user from their current lobby and adds them as a peer in the attacker's lobby.

finding.guards_checked: SessionMiddleware only. host.go never reads models.SessionOrPanic (the other lobby handlers do). The only check is that the user id exists. Impact: impersonation and forced eviction of a victim from their match. The victim's user id is a small int32, so it is enumerable from profile and relationship endpoints (not verified).
